game_concept: A strategy race set in Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones, standing whisper stones: the scholar mage must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Shelf Sorter: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of carved tiles from smallest to largest.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones: standing whisper stones
core_gameplay_loop: In Whisper Stones, repeat each round: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of carved tiles from smallest to largest. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the scholar mage ahead. Then check the order_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the crypt seal by solving code steps involving order_score that move the scholar mage forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the crypt seal first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 8 (extended tier): Shelf Sorter
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Shelf Sorter' (Week 7 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Whisper Stones'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how order_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Whisper Stones.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
